nodes.label: Upload endpoint (POST /microfrontends/by-slug/{slug}/upload/{version})
nodes.rationale: Everything the provider-specific pipelines do reduces to this one HTTP call: multipart ZIP upload authenticated by api-key header, project derived from the key. Re-uploading an existing version overwrites in place, which silently changes what deployed users get, so publishing a new version is preferred. Custom URL microfrontends cannot be uploaded to.

nodes.label: ZIP archive layout rule
nodes.rationale: The archive must contain the contents of the build output, not the folder itself; a dist/ prefix inside the zip shifts the entry point to dist/assets/remoteEntry.js, mismatching the configured entry point so every request 404s. Zip from inside the output directory.
